snippet.title: Torizon Telecom Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Torizon Telecom is a 3D text-graphic based first-person shooter (FPS)
where you fight in a massive world made entirely of characters: "Telecom."

Everything is Text.

Wishlist Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4599560/Torizon_Telecom
